breakpoints.note: First non-harness project statement that consumes the three attacker-controlled instruction bytes and materializes the x86 decode state later printed by the vulnerable x86 formatter.

Root cause. In 32-bit mode the selected register-size table stops at `X86_REG_R15W`. In the same vulnerable commit, `include/capstone/x86.h` and `X86MappingReg.inc` already define public/register-map entries for `X86_REG_BND0..X86_REG_BND3`, so the earlier `printOperand()` lookup for `X86_REG_BND3` has no defined in-bounds 16-byte element to use on this witness path. The fix appends four trailing `16` entries here; the same omission also exists in `regsize_map_64`.
